_comment: Harness capability manifest — Claude Code. This is the SOURCE layout (generation spec, contract 2): the plugin's own commands/, agents/, skills/ and hooks/hooks.json are already in Claude Code's shapes, so nothing is emitted for it (emit: false). The manifest still exists in full because the portability lint reads every harness's vocabulary, and a token only Claude Code understands is only detectable as unmapped in another harness's tree if Claude Code's own names are written down somewhere. It carries no `lint` block and an empty `rewrites` because linting runs over emitted trees only. Shape contributed by Maxim Podreshetnikov (PR #13); `verified`, `output_channels`, `scope_reason`, `root_placeholder_literal` and `agent_overrides` are the spec's additions.

verified.session: the shipped plugin's own hooks, run continuously in this repository under Claude Code 2.1.163+ — not one session but daily operation; each output_channels row cites where the fact is observed

install.mechanism: the package's own registration through its distribution shell, or the built-in plugin marketplace
install.shell_reason: the distribution shell that installs this harness from npm (the layout ADR decision 6; the shells ADR): `npx projectstore-claude install --project <dir>` is the core's `install --harness claude-code`, with the core pinned at the same version and bundled inside the shell's tarball. Data, not `projectstore-<id>`: the id is claude-code and the reserved, published name is projectstore-claude. Every command a finding or a deferred reason names is built from this key (harness.mjs packageCommand).
install.why_not_scripted: Two channels. `npx projectstore-claude install --project <dir>` registers the plugin for that project from the npm package itself — the shell bundles the core and fixes the harness; the core's low-level form is `npx projectstore install --harness claude-code --project <dir>` — through a local marketplace under the Claude home, driven by Claude Code's own `claude plugin` CLI. `/plugin install projectstore@SmartAndPoint` installs it from the git marketplace. `/plugin` lists and toggles either. Upgrading the npm registration is `npx projectstore-claude@<version> upgrade --project <dir>` — that is also the pin.
steps: npx projectstore-claude install --project "$PWD"   (npm; registers the plugin for this project — the shell runs the core's install with the harness fixed)
/plugin marketplace add SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore && /plugin install projectstore@SmartAndPoint   (git marketplace, user-wide)
notes: Git marketplace only: auto-update is OFF by default for third-party plugins: /plugin -> Marketplaces -> SmartAndPoint -> toggle auto-update. The npm registration updates when you run `npx projectstore-claude upgrade --project <dir>`.
Pin a git-marketplace release with: /plugin marketplace add SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore#<tag>; pin the npm registration with npx projectstore-claude@<version>.

Two enabled copies of the plugin (git marketplace and npm) in one checkout would load twice; the npm registration silences the other one for that checkout only (settings.local.json), and says so in its preview.

The npm registration is per checkout (local scope) and per machine; a fresh clone or a new worktree runs the install command again. It must run from a terminal outside a Claude Code session: the host CLI and a live session both rewrite settings files.

runtime.harness_dir_reason: the harness's own directory in a project: how it is detected, where its settings live — never where projectstore's config is (the layout ADR, 2026-09-06: that is <project>/.projectstore/, one for every harness)

agent_overrides.beats: every projectstore model configuration, per-invocation parameter included

runtime.session_env_reason: set to 1 in every Bash tool of a live session (measured 2026-09-05, 2.1.261); detect_env names the variables a hook or plugin process receives, which a Bash tool does not — the two questions differ.
runtime.overlay_reason: the file under <project>/.projectstore/harness/ that carries this harness's agents block — the models, per agent, that plugin surfaces pass per invocation (ADR-008; the layout ADR decision 3)

hooks._root_placeholder_literal_comment: true = the harness passes the placeholder through as literal text and the installer must substitute an absolute path; false = the harness expands it. Claude Code expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}, so false. Measured value for Codex comes from the spike.

output_channels._comment: Per-event output channels (generation spec, contract 17). `fields` are the hookSpecificOutput keys the event honours; `system_message` is the top-level systemMessage; `decision` names the decision object where one exists. `evidence` is `measured` only where this repository's own hooks observe the fact, `documented` where the Claude Code hooks reference says so and we never emit it.

SessionStart.note: hooks/session-start.mjs emits additionalContext and systemMessage in one object; the ~10,000-character cap on additionalContext was measured (vault story: SessionStart context exceeds the hook output cap).

PreToolUse.note: systemMessage measured — scripts/touch-session.mjs uses it for the pointer nudge and the name offer. additionalContext and permissionDecision (allow|deny|ask) are documented; projectstore never emits them. A separate PermissionRequest event carries its own decision object.

PostToolUse.note: scripts/touch-session.mjs — the entry-rule reminder's primary carrier (entry-rule spec, contract 14).

PostToolUseFailure.note: Hooks reference; not registered by projectstore.

PostToolBatch.note: Hooks reference; not registered by projectstore.

UserPromptSubmit.note: Hooks reference; not registered by projectstore.

Stop.note: additionalContext on Stop CONTINUES the turn (2.1.163 changelog) — hooks/session-stop.mjs runs a create-then-emit election because of it. Below 2.1.163 only decision:block + reason exists.

SubagentStop.note: Same channel as Stop per the 2.1.163 changelog; not registered by projectstore — a subagent is the actor that cannot open a story.

PreCompact.note: Measured NEGATIVELY: an output object containing additionalContext is rejected whole, taking systemMessage down with it (hooks/pre-compact.mjs; vault story: PreCompact survival packet targets a channel PreCompact does not have). Only top-level decision/reason and systemMessage exist.

commands.scope_reason: Claude Code loads commands from the plugin installation itself, not from a per-project directory.

agents.scope_reason: Claude Code loads agents from the plugin installation itself, not from a per-project directory.

skills.scope_reason: Claude Code loads skills from the plugin installation itself, not from a per-project directory.

hooks.scope_reason: Claude Code loads the plugin's hooks.json from the plugin installation itself; per-project hooks live in settings, which projectstore does not write.

agents_block.scope_reason: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md from the project root; AGENTS.md is the cross-tool convention, bridged by an @AGENTS.md import (ADR-002 decision 3).

statusline.scope_reason: The statusLine slot is per project and not plugin-declarable (ADR-006); our entry lives in settings.local.json, which is machine-specific.

statusline_launcher.scope_reason: The launcher resolves the currently installed plugin on every render, so the wired command carries no version; it is written only when the plugin runs from the marketplace cache — a dev checkout is wired directly.
statusline_launcher.file_reason: the harness's generated runtime files live under .projectstore/state/<harness id>/ (layout ADR decision 4); the 0.27.x path .claude/.projectstore/statusline.mjs is read as ours through 0.29

mcp.scope_reason: Claude Code loads a plugin's .mcp.json from the plugin installation itself and expands ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} in it per session, so the one shipped file binds each server to one project (MCP ADR decision 6, amended 2026-09-05); nothing is installed and nothing is derived — the host kind install-harness skips, which the install spec's contract 0 does not yet name.

launch.unset_placeholder_in_args: inferred literal — the server refuses a --project still carrying a dollar-brace placeholder
launch.entrypoint: sdk-cli (headless -p), plugin loaded with --plugin-dir; the marketplace install and an interactive session are A9's

mcp_project_entry.scope_reason: A project-root .mcp.json registers the server with an absolute --project for a host that does not expand placeholders (MCP ADR, decision 6); per project because the server binds to one.
mcp_project_entry.why_unsupported: the plugin-bundled registration already binds per project in Claude Code; this row is for hosts without plugin MCP and lands with their adapters (roadmap B3/C3)

plugin.scope_reason: Claude Code registers a plugin per scope (user, project, local, managed). The registration carries a machine-absolute path and an enablement, so it lands in the checkout's settings.local.json — the same machine-specific file the status line uses — never in the committed settings.json and never in the user's own settings (install spec contract 4′, 2026-09-05). Local scope is per checkout: a worktree registers again.

verified.evidence: measured in a sandboxed CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with two projects
notes: plugin.json wins over the marketplace entry's version
--scope local writes only <project>/.claude/settings.local.json (extraKnownMarketplaces, enabledPlugins) and one registry row per project carrying projectPath
`plugin update <id> --scope local -y` swaps that project's row in place after the directory is rewritten; without --scope it looks at user scope and fails
`plugin uninstall --scope local -y` removes only the calling project's row and enablement

`marketplace remove` (any scope) empties known_marketplaces.json AND every project's rows for that marketplace — run only when no other project uses it; the project's own extraKnownMarketplaces entry is removed by install itself
`plugin validate` warns about the unknown `projectstore` field and exits 0
-y accepts a marketplace-declared command; this marketplace declares none
the project of a --scope local command is the process cwd; there is no --project flag
a live session marks its Bash environment with CLAUDECODE=1 (not the plugin-root or project-dir variables, which reach hooks only); the registration defers on that marker
`plugin update` at an unchanged version answers "already at the latest version" and copies nothing, even after `marketplace update`: a same-version content refresh is uninstall + install

plugin.condition_reason: any root that is not the host's own plugin cache — the npm package under npx, a global install, a dev checkout — registers; a session running from the cache never registers a second copy of itself.

update_instructions: **About future updates**: installed from the git marketplace, Claude Code does NOT auto-update third-party marketplaces by default (an npm registration updates with `npx projectstore-claude upgrade --project <dir>`). To get notified of new releases (v0.7+):
Without it, you would run `/plugin marketplace update SmartAndPoint` manually. See https://github.com/SmartAndPoint/ProjectStore#upgrading for details.

**Upgrading from 0.27.x to 0.28**: restart after the update. The status line keeps rendering; the first session names the one step — `/projectstore:doctor --fix` — that re-stamps the launcher written before file stamps existed. `status` and `search` answer from artifact facts; `doctor` gains surface, version-drift and mcp lines and exits 1 on findings; the plugin registers an MCP server the host may ask you to approve once. Rolling back overwrites the stamp; coming forward costs the same one `--fix`.
